description: This Java class 'FixedDepositAccountHelper' provides helper methods to create, manage, and test fixed deposit accounts within the Fineract microfinance platform, including applying, approving, rejecting, withdrawing, activating, closing, and calculating interest on fixed deposit accounts for integration testing purposes.

classes.name: FixedDepositAccountHelper
classes.description: Helper class for creating, managing, and testing fixed deposit accounts in integration tests for the Fineract platform.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Constructs a JSON string representing a fixed deposit application with specified parameters.

methods.name: applyFixedDepositApplicationGetId
methods.description: Submits a fixed deposit application JSON to create a new account and returns its ID.

methods.name: applyFixedDepositApplication
methods.description: Submits a fixed deposit application JSON to create a new account and returns the server response.

methods.name: getFixedDepositAccountById
methods.description: Retrieves data of a fixed deposit account by its ID.

methods.name: getFixedDepositSummary
methods.description: Retrieves a summary of a fixed deposit account.

methods.name: getFixedDepositDetails
methods.description: Retrieves detailed information of a fixed deposit account.

methods.name: getInterestRate
methods.description: Calculates the interest rate based on interest slabs and deposit period.

methods.name: getPrincipalAfterCompoundingInterest
methods.description: Computes the principal amount after applying interest with compounding over the deposit period.

methods.name: updateFixedDepositAccount
methods.description: Updates the fixed deposit account with new details like dates and interest types.

methods.name: updateInterestCalculationConfigForFixedDeposit
methods.description: Updates interest calculation configuration parameters for an existing fixed deposit account.

methods.name: approveFixedDeposit
methods.description: Approves a fixed deposit account, marking it as approved.

methods.name: undoApproval
methods.description: Reverts the approval of a fixed deposit account.

methods.name: rejectApplication
methods.description: Rejects a fixed deposit application.

methods.name: withdrawApplication
methods.description: Withdraws a fixed deposit application.

methods.name: activateFixedDeposit
methods.description: Activates a fixed deposit account.

methods.name: deleteFixedDepositApplication
methods.description: Deletes a fixed deposit application record.

methods.name: calculateInterestForFixedDeposit
methods.description: Calculates interest for a fixed deposit account.

methods.name: postInterestForFixedDeposit
methods.description: Posts accrued interest for a fixed deposit account.

methods.name: calculatePrematureAmountForFixedDeposit
methods.description: Calculates the amount payable if the deposit is closed prematurely.

methods.name: prematureCloseForFixedDeposit
methods.description: Performs a premature closure of a fixed deposit account.

methods.name: closeForFixedDeposit
methods.description: Closes a fixed deposit account.
